# Tools & remarks

## Convenient tools

<font color=red>

- Napari
- Bapy
- Stardist, 
- Cellpose, 
- Microsam, 
- organoidtracker
- biapy
- https://github.com/hallvaaw/awesome-biological-image-analysis

Suggested by LLM:

- Napari: interactive multidimensional image viewer with a rich plugin ecosystem
StarDist: robust nucleus and cell instance segmentation using star-convex shapes
Cellpose: generalist deep-learning segmentation for many cell types with easy GUI and Python API
- micro-sam: SAM-based interactive and automated segmentation workflows for microscopy
OrganoidTracker: tracking and lineage analysis for organoid time-lapse data
- BaSiCPy: illumination and background correction (very useful preprocessing step)
scikit-image: core Python toolbox for classical image processing
- OpenCV: fast, broad computer-vision toolkit useful for filtering, morphology, transforms, and geometry
- SimpleITK: strong for registration, resampling, and medical/microscopy image operations

- ilastik: user-friendly pixel/object classification and segmentation with minimal coding
- Squidpy: spatial omics analysis with image feature extraction support

- CellProfiler: pipeline-based high-throughput image analysis and feature extraction

Non-python convenient tools;

- Fiji ImageJ: classic GUI platform with many plugins and macro support
- TrackMate: easy and powerful particle/cell tracking in Fiji

</red>
